title: Action items
summary: The action tracker: a progress bar reading N of M done, filters by state, a grouping toggle (by state, owner or source), and a table with the id, the handle over the full title, the owner, the source cited as a chip, the state pill with the due date, and the linked pull requests and issues with their live GitHub state when the site carries a token. An action counts as done when its state is done or a link marked closes has merged. The page renders one in Action items; declare one to start grouped by owner or to hide finished work.

showDone.description: list done and dropped items; default true
